summary: A template-update review demo that identifies outdated working files and presents readable change summaries with Apply or Decline decisions.

challenge.title: Helping users understand template changes without opening every working file.
challenge.description: Reviewing template updates can be slow when each engagement takes significant time to open. The exercise explores how to identify pending versions and explain changes before asking a user to make a decision.

solution.title: Separating version analysis from a focused review interface.
solution.description: I built Java logic for accumulated version checks and readable diff summaries alongside an Angular review screen with fixture data and Apply/Decline interactions. The default branch contains separate frontend and backend excerpts; the architecture documents a proposed metadata index, while an alternative branch explores an integrated implementation.
